items.title: Van Veen edges past Wade to book Price SF showdown in Blackpool
items.summary: Gian van Veen set up a semi-final showdown with Gerwyn Price at the World Matchplay after an eventful 16-13 win over James Wade in Blackpool.

items.title: Maresca's Man City vow: I am not a 'copy and paste' coach
items.summary: Enzo Maresca has vowed not to be a "copy and paste" coach in his first press conference since succeeding Pep Guardiola as Man City manager.
